title: atlax extraction overrides (atlax/overrides.yaml)
description: Optional, in an artifact repo beside plant.yaml: what the extractors are told when the code's shape cannot be read, before any fuzzy reading (docs/atlas/implementation.md step 3). Writer: the artifact's FSE, or atlax-agent proposing one when a finding is noise. Reader: claudecode bin/atlax (scripts/atlax/wailscli.py) in verify, touches and derive. Sample: overrides.sample.yaml.

short.description: The <short> in derived fn:<short>.<Struct>.<Method> and fn:<short>.cli.<command> designations, when plant.yaml names no short (plant.yaml short wins; verify warns when they differ); default the artifact id without a leading `agent-`.

dispatch.description: dir:func, each a function whose switch on an argument's [0] lists the commands, when main's dispatch cannot be followed.

commands.description: The commands verbatim, when no switch can be read. Wins over dispatch. Taken as present: a command removed from the code still derives from here, so an authored one listed here can never redline; prefer dispatch, and keep this list by hand. Each command's evidence is its line in this file.

flags_only.description: Directories (cmd/kbcheck; . for the module root) whose main reads os.Args only to parse flags and dispatches no command: no warning, and no command is made up (atlax-tool-followups-2 V5). A main that hands os.Args[1:] to a flag set's Parse, directly or through the functions it passes it to, and reads no positional argument back, is read so with go/ast and needs no entry.

bind.description: dir:Type, each a type bound to the frontend whose Bind: entry cannot be read (options built elsewhere, a value of unreadable type); its exported methods become elements, with this line as the binding's evidence. ".:App" is a type in the module root.

ignore.description: Bindings that are never elements: Struct.Method in package main, else go.<pkg>.Struct.Method.
